title: Jolly Crunchy American Popcorn Bowl
description: Roasted, crispy popcorn coated with maple toffee and spicy seasonings, topped with deep-fried pickled cucumber and pumpkin seeds, served in a rustic earthenware bowl.
instructions: Heat 2 tbsp coconut oil in a large pot over medium until shimmering.
Add 1 cup popcorn kernels, cover, and shake when popping starts; remove from heat when popping slows.
Transfer popped kernels to a large bowl and coat with 1 tsp sea salt, 1 tsp smoked paprika, and 1/2 tsp chili powder.
Drizzle 3 tbsp maple syrup and 1/4 tsp vanilla extract over the popcorn, tossing until evenly coated.
Spread the coated popcorn on a parchment-lined baking sheet and roast in a 300°F oven for 15 minutes, stirring once, until crisp.
While the popcorn roasts, combine 1 cup sliced cucumber, 2 tbsp rice vinegar, 1/4 tsp salt, and a pinch of cayenne pepper in a bowl and let sit for 5 minutes to pickle.
Heat 1 tbsp coconut oil in a small skillet over medium-high; add the pickled cucumber slices and fry 2–3 minutes until browned and crisp, then drain on paper towels.
Sprinkle 1/4 cup toasted pumpkin seeds over the roasted popcorn, top with the deep-fried pickled cucumber, and drizzle any remaining maple syrup if desired.
Serve immediately in an earthenware bowl.
